The applications as at (A) & (B) under section 389 Cr.P.C. have been filed for suspension of execution of sentence imposed upon Appellant No.1,
namely, Tunu @ Hare Kishan and Appellant No.2, namely, Prahalad Kishan by the Trial Court while convicting him for the offence under section 376(D)/506/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with section 6 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 by the learned Additional District & Sessions Judge- Cum-Presiding Officer, Special Court (POCSO), Sundergarh in Special G.R. Case No.33 of 2014 (Trial No.207 of 2020), pending disposal of this Appeal and for their release on bail.
2.

entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: Heard learned Counsel for the Appellant Nos.1 & 2 and learned Additional Standing Counsel for the Respondent-State.

3. Taking into account the submissions made and on going through the judgment passed by the Trial Court as well as the depositions of the prosecution witnesses, at this stage, while this Court is not inclined to direct for suspension of further execution of the sentence and grant them bail pending disposal of this Appeal, these applications stand disposed of granting interim bail to Appellant No.1, namely, Tunu @ Hare Kishan and Appellant No.2, namely, Prahalad Kishan for a period of three months from the date of their actual release from custody on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper by the learned Additional District & Sessions Judge-Cum-Presiding Officer, Special Court (POCSO), Sundergarh in the aforesaid case with further conditions that they shall not indulge themselves in any criminal activity during the period of interim bail; and shall positively surrender before the Trial Court as would be so directed by the said Court on expiry of period of interim bail.
Issue urgent certified copy of this order as per rules.
